stage: CUBE-REV 0.10.5-R1.9 — Phase-objective Quotient Geometry, Attempt-level Familywise Null Preregistration & Fresh-vintage Replication Readiness
intent: Replace R1.8's exact phase-endpoint full-state distance with phase-objective quotient geometry that explicitly ignores task-irrelevant state coordinates, and replace segment-tail-then-any-exceedance testing with a directly calibrated attempt-level familywise null. R1.9 is a historical-development and future-readiness stage: no R1.7/R1.8 record may be relabeled confirmatory, and no recovery/error prevalence claim may be made from R1.9 development results.

historical_data_status.r17_900: HISTORICAL_DEVELOPMENT_ONLY; outcomes and R1.8 analyses are already known.
historical_data_status.r18_900: HISTORICAL_DEVELOPMENT_ONLY; it was prospective for R1.8 but is not a fresh holdout for R1.9.
historical_data_status.future_confirmatory_data: Only reconstruction IDs absent from the frozen historical reconstruction universe AND official-attempt keys absent from both R1.7 and R1.8 may enter a later confirmatory replication.

phase_frame.center_canonicalization: Every intermediate KPattern is mapped to a fixed physical cube frame by the unique whole-cube orientation whose center-piece permutation equals the solved center permutation. Center orientation is ignored. Any non-unique or missing canonicalization is a blocking validator failure.
phase_frame.face_supports: U,D,R,L,F,B edge/corner position supports are derived from the pinned cubing.js 3x3 KTransformation definitions rather than hard-coded cubie indices.
phase_frame.cfop_zb_cross_face: For CFOP/ZB routes, the first eligible CROSS endpoint after center canonicalization must contain an exactly solved four-edge face star. If multiple face stars qualify, select the face with the greatest number of solved positions in the corresponding F2L domain; remaining ties are deterministic U,D,R,L,F,B order and are reported. If none qualifies, CFOP/ZB quotient geometry for that route is inadmissible.
phase_frame.last_layer_face: The face opposite the detected cross face.
phase_frame.f2l_domain: All edge and corner positions not moved by a turn of the detected last-layer face. This quotient removes last-layer coordinates by construction.

CROSS.objective: Full piece+orientation agreement with the phase endpoint on the four edge positions incident to the detected cross face.
CROSS.quotiented_out: All corners and all non-cross edges.
CROSS.admission: All four cross-edge endpoint coordinates must be solved in the canonical frame.

F2L.objective: Full piece+orientation agreement with the phase endpoint only on positions inside the F2L domain that are solved at that endpoint.
F2L.quotiented_out: All last-layer positions and every not-yet-solved F2L-domain position.
F2L.admission: The endpoint must add at least one solved edge and one solved corner inside the F2L domain relative to line start, while retaining an exact solved cross.

LL_ORIENT.objective: Orientation agreement only on last-layer edge+corner positions.
LL_ORIENT.anchor: Full piece+orientation agreement with the phase endpoint on solved F2L-domain positions is tracked as a separate anchor-break channel, not mixed into objective distance.

LL_PERMUTE.objective: Piece-position agreement only on last-layer edge+corner positions, minimized over the four U-equivalent/AUF-equivalent representatives of the endpoint after mapping the detected last layer to the canonical U action by conjugation.
LL_PERMUTE.quotiented_out: Last-layer orientation and AUF-equivalent endpoint representatives.
LL_PERMUTE.anchor: Solved F2L-domain structure is a separate anchor-break channel.

LL_ONELOOK.objective: Full piece+orientation agreement on last-layer edge+corner positions, minimized over AUF-equivalent endpoint representatives.
LL_ONELOOK.quotiented_out: Only AUF-equivalent endpoint representatives and non-last-layer coordinates.
LL_ONELOOK.anchor: Solved F2L-domain structure is a separate anchor-break channel.

ROUX_FB.objective: Dynamic solved-support quotient: full piece+orientation agreement only on edge/corner positions that are solved at the phase endpoint, with at least three newly solved positions relative to line start.
ROUX_FB.claim_scope: Roux reconstruction-frame engineering metric; not asserted to be a unique cognitive first-block representation.

ROUX_SB.objective: Dynamic solved-support quotient: full piece+orientation agreement only on endpoint-solved edge/corner positions, with at least two newly solved positions relative to line start.
ROUX_SB.claim_scope: Roux reconstruction-frame engineering metric; not asserted to identify subjective block choice.

ROUX_CMLL.objective: Full piece+orientation agreement on all corners, with edges quotiented out; AUF-equivalent endpoint representatives are allowed when transformation-equivalent in the canonical frame.
ROUX_CMLL.quotiented_out: All edges except that existing solved-support anchors are separately audited.

ROUX_LSE.objective: Full piece+orientation agreement on all edges, corners quotiented out; AUF-equivalent endpoint representatives are allowed.

line_features.objective_backtrack: On the phase-objective quotient distance path, the maximum increase above the running best that subsequently returns to or below that pre-excursion best strictly before the final phase move. Final-endpoint-only return is ineligible, preserving the R1.8 anti-triviality rule.
line_features.anchor_break_peak: For phases with an anchor channel, the maximum full-state mismatch fraction on anchor coordinates at any intermediate move. This is an excursion feature, not called recovery.
line_features.distance_normalization: Each objective or anchor channel is normalized by the number of active comparison coordinates, so raw distances lie in [0,1]. Empty masks are inadmissible rather than assigned zero.
line_features.secondary_checks: Unweighted coordinate-count versions of every primary quotient channel are retained for invariant and candidate agreement audits.

algorithm_aware_reference.observed_historical_path: Included in the historical reference envelope as a conservative ordinary-route realization; this cannot prove the route cognitively clean.
algorithm_aware_reference.representation_variants: Only rewrites whose full KTransformation is exactly identical to the original phase transformation are admitted.
algorithm_aware_reference.solver_alternative: Pinned cubing.js solver alternatives are admitted only when full KTransformation identity is exact; physical-only equivalence is diagnostic and excluded from the primary reference.
algorithm_aware_reference.matched_statistic_rule: Every reference realization is scored with the exact same quotient feature as the observed line. R1.8's max-excursion versus candidate-reversal mismatch is forbidden.

local_tail_normalization.purpose: Map heterogeneous phase/channel amplitudes to conservative empirical tail scores before the attempt-level maximum is formed.
local_tail_normalization.tail_probability: add-one conservative empirical upper-tail probability: (1 + # reference amplitudes >= observed amplitude) / (n + 1)

attempt_level_familywise_null.attempt_statistic: Maximum local tail_score over all eligible phase-line objective and anchor channels in one official attempt.
attempt_level_familywise_null.crossfit: Deterministic 5-fold split by SHA-256 of official-attempt key and R1.9 salt. Each held-out attempt is scored only against reference envelopes from the other four folds.
attempt_level_familywise_null.multiplicity_conditioning: Familywise reference is conditioned by eligible feature-count bin: 1-8, 9-12, 13-16, 17+ when bin n>=300; otherwise global. Method×feature-count may be used only when n>=300 and is predeclared before execution; fallback order is method×count -> count -> method -> global with n>=300 for non-global levels.
attempt_level_familywise_null.future_familywise_p: For a fresh attempt, score against the full sealed historical local reference, then compute add-one upper-tail probability against the sealed cross-fitted historical attempt-statistic reference at the highest supported multiplicity-conditioning level.
attempt_level_familywise_null.calibration_health_gate: Across five held-out folds, empirical primary-alpha exceedance must lie in [0.003,0.02] overall; secondary-watch exceedance must lie in [0.025,0.08]. These are engineering calibration-health bands, not hypothesis-test acceptance regions.

historical_evaluation.prohibited: No historical cross-fitted exceedance is a new recovery prevalence estimate or independent replication.

fresh_vintage_readiness.historical_baseline_source: R1.8 live-vintage audit; exact ID set must be materialized from the frozen R1.6 analytical DB before future admission.
fresh_vintage_readiness.fresh_record: reco_id absent from frozen historical ID set AND official-attempt key absent from R1.7 and R1.8; reconstructed route must pass parser/state/frame/quotient validators after the R1.9 metric+null seal.
fresh_vintage_readiness.fresh_any_gate: At least 200 new unique-linked state-certified attempts with >=3 supported speed×era cells and weight ESS>=100 before any standardized replication estimate.
fresh_vintage_readiness.fresh_modern_7_10_gate: At least 80 new unique-linked state-certified attempts in 2023-26 × 7-10 s before an independent modern-cell replication claim.
fresh_vintage_readiness.zero_new_records_behavior: READINESS_PASS_DATA_WAIT; do not recycle historical attempts and do not weaken gates.

falsifiers: A whole-cube rotation changes quotient distance after center canonicalization.
Changing a coordinate declared quotiented-out changes the primary objective distance.
The canonical endpoint has nonzero objective distance to its own quotient class.
A U/AUF-equivalent PLL or one-look endpoint receives nonzero objective distance.
Any cross-fitted held-out attempt contributes to its own local or familywise reference distribution.
Local-reference fallback occurs for >5% of eligible historical features.
Primary or secondary calibration-health bands fail after implementation bugs and deterministic split are ruled out.
Fresh-vintage admission cannot prove both reco-ID and official-attempt-key novelty.

allowed_in_r19: Engineering validation of phase-objective quotient geometry on historical reconstructions.
Cross-fitted calibration-health characteristics of the preregistered attempt-level familywise null.
Readiness or HOLD status for future fresh-vintage replication.
Descriptive comparison showing how quotienting changes historical route geometry, explicitly labeled historical development.
prohibited_in_r19: Independent replication using R1.7 or R1.8 attempts.
Causal, intentional, awareness, or strategy-switching mechanism claims.
Fresh modern replication if the fresh-modern gate is not met.
Treating annotations as ground-truth latent cognitive subgoals.
Changing quotient masks, tail hierarchy, familywise alpha, or freshness criteria after observing a future fresh attempt.
